text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, February 26, 2022, Appeal DDRT2022-05.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, and directed that the conditions of the order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Giti Zare and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before June 10, 2022.
